The '''Action VI bulk transport''', sometimes referred to as the '''bulk transport''' and the '''modified action transport''', was a popular [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] built by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ActionVITransport-SotGSagaEdition.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Action VI transports in a convoy]]
Action VI transports typically operated in convoys or in well patrolled areas of space. Since they lacked even the most basic forms of self-defensive measures, such as armor and weaponry, they were often prime targets for pirates and so had to rely on protection from other [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and starfighter escorts. The only reason they were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was because they were quite inexpensive relative to Imperial wealth. [[Crashed merchant vessel|One of these ships]] once crashed on Blenjeel, after crossing paths with an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]].

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] also employed these cargo vessels, often as personnel carriers, but in much smaller quantities since they were far more expensive than [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. Most Action VIs were stolen from the Empire.

Pirates often modified Action VI ships into "[[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|interceptor frigates]]" capable of combating [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]]. The most famous Action VI was ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]].

==Behind the scenes==
An Action VI transport was inserted into [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="HB">{{HBCite|61}}</ref>
